findings.finding: The independent NIQ/RSM tracker shows pub LFL of only +0.4% in October 2026, with groups outside the M25 at -0.3%. Marston's regional, locals-heavy estate is therefore likely to report a roughly flat start to FY27, while listed peers reported JDW +8.2% (14 weeks to 1 Nov) and Fuller's +5.8% (32 weeks to 7 Nov). That relative gap is the line on which the stock fell 13% in January 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 28 Jan 2026: flat 17-week LFL against M&B's +4.5% sent the stock down 13.35% over the window (JPMorgan pointed to the peer gap). 13 Oct 2026: Q4 LFL 'broadly flat' came alongside a profit beat and the stock rose 14.72%.
findings.source_date: 2026-11 (October 2026 data; the page refers to the Autumn Budget 2026 and carries no date)
findings.why_not_priced: Marston's has said nothing on FY27 trading. The stock has eased 4% over five sessions, which is consistent with partial pricing, and nothing on the register shows a short positioned for a miss. If the market fully expected a weak start, the October run-up of +14.7% would have unwound further.
findings.independence: Peer prints from different documents: JDW 4 Nov 2026 https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/wetherspoon-j-d---jdw/trading-update-announcement/9856806 ; Fuller's 11 Nov 2026 https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/fuller-smith-turner--fsta/half-year-results/9868651 . Both set a high relative bar and are London- or value-skewed, so this is a proxy with two-sided risk.

findings.finding: Autumn Budget 2026 raises business-rates relief for eligible pubs in England from 15% to 35% from 1 April 2027, which partly offsets the 3.9% National Living Wage rise in Marston's FY27 cost-headwind guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolated. In H1 FY26 the company said labour efficiencies 'fully offset' the NLW and NIC increases, and the stock's prelims reactions have tracked the profit and cash lines.
findings.source_date: 2026 (Budget 2026 measure page; restaurantonline's Budget reaction is dated 2026-10-28)
findings.why_not_priced: The measure is public, but Marston's has not quantified it. Its FY27 net cost headwind is first given at the prelims, and analysts at a 3-7-name coverage may not have modelled the half-year of relief. This is macro-to-company transmission and is kept small.
findings.independence: RSM/NIQ October tracker commentary: the Budget 'left the sector relatively unscathed' https://www.rsmuk.com/insights/hospitality-business-tracker/flat-october-for-hospitality-as-consumers-stay-cautious-before-christmas

findings.finding: The Board pre-committed to announce a shareholder-returns programme, expected to be buybacks, at these prelims. The size is unknown, and leverage closed at c.4.2x against the 'around 4.0x by year end' path guided in May, which limits how large it can be.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First buyback in this sequence. The 25 Nov 2025 prelims, where the cash-flow target was hit early, moved +18.0%. That reaction reads on the cash line, not on a return.
findings.why_not_priced: The intent was priced in October, but the size was not. At roughly £370m market cap (640m shares x 56.6p), each £10m of buyback is about 2.7% of the equity, so the amount is a real number nobody has. The leverage miss against the company's own 4.0x path is the caveat, and it holds the size down.
findings.independence: H1 FY26 RNS leverage path, a different document: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/marston-s--mars/results-for-the-26-weeks-ended-28-march-2026-/9562889

findings.finding: Long-only value holders are concentrating: Aberforth rose from 11.01% to 16.69% of voting rights on 9 Nov 2026 as the Wellcome Trust sold out of 5.02% the same day, and Clap Capital disclosed a new 5.35% on 11 Oct 2026. The supply overhang is absorbed and no disclosed short sits against it.
findings.why_not_priced: These are public TR-1s, so mostly priced. The point is the reaction function: a concentrated, value-holder register with no short makes a disappointment-led gap down less likely to be pressed.

lessons_applied: Understatement / 'size the move on what is new': raised abs_move_pct from 5.5 to 6.5 because the FY27 outlook, buyback size and leverage targets are new lines on a 3-7 analyst, $0.9m/day name whose last prelims moved +18%; p_up unchanged at 52
'A finding about a number already told is worth 0': the pre-released FY26 PBT finding was already at 0.0, so nothing changed
'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series': the current-trading finding already rested on the broad tracker over the London-skewed peers, so its size was unchanged
'Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company says it': the Budget rates-relief finding was cut from +0.3 to +0.2, so impact_sum fell from 0.3 in the draft to 0.2
